description: Scores a password by information entropy: character-pool size, length, crack-time against an offline attack (10^10 guesses/s), and common-password/pattern detection. Evaluated in memory only, never stored or logged — the honest math behind 'is this password good?'. Use this when an agent needs to entropy bits + realistic crack-time estimate. x402 price $0.002/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_password_strength
title: Password Strength Meter
